description.zh: RESTful & GraphQL API 设计专家——站在消费者视角设计端点，输出 OpenAPI 3.1 + 错误码 + 分页 + 版本控制 + 限流策略的一体化规范文档；帮你从“能调用”进到“好用、好维护、好扩展”。
description.en: RESTful & GraphQL API design expert — design endpoints from the consumer perspective, producing unified spec documents with OpenAPI 3.1 + error codes + pagination + versioning + rate limiting; taking your APIs from 'working' to 'great to use, maintain, and extend'.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你的业务场景和使用者，我来设计一套规范的 API
welcome_message.en: Tell me your business scenario and consumers, and I'll design a clean API spec for you

description.zh: 从资源建模到端点规范，输出完整 RESTful API
description.en: From resource modeling to endpoint specs, produce a complete RESTful API

prompt.zh: 请帮我设计一套 RESTful API：先梳理资源与关系，再定义端点、HTTP 动词与状态码，最后输出含示例的 OpenAPI 3.1 YAML。
prompt.en: Design a RESTful API: model resources and relationships, define endpoints + HTTP verbs + status codes, then output OpenAPI 3.1 YAML with examples.

description.zh: 类型、Resolver、批处理与 N+1 防护的 Schema 设计
description.en: Design types, resolvers, batching, and N+1 protection in GraphQL

prompt.zh: 请帮我设计一套 GraphQL Schema：包括类型定义、Query/Mutation、Resolver 批处理策略（DataLoader）、以及 N+1 防护方案。
prompt.en: Design a GraphQL schema: type definitions, queries/mutations, resolver batching (DataLoader), and N+1 prevention.

description.zh: 统一错误码规范与向后兼容的版本控制方案
description.en: Unified error code conventions and backward-compatible versioning

prompt.zh: 请帮我设计一套统一的错误码规范（含请求 ID、错误链路、i18n）和版本控制策略（URI / Header / 语义化版本），并给出向后兼容的迁移路径。
prompt.en: Design unified error codes (request ID, error chain, i18n) and a versioning strategy (URI / Header / semver) with a backward-compatible migration path.

zh: 设计一个用户管理模块的 RESTful API（用户 CRUD + 角色权限 + 多端接入），输出 OpenAPI YAML
把现有分散的接口重新整理并统一错误码体系和分页约定
每周三10:00检查团队新接口是否符合 RESTful Level 3 Richardson Maturity Model
en: Design a RESTful API for a user management module (CRUD + role-based access + multi-platform), output OpenAPI YAML
Consolidate scattered existing endpoints and unify error codes and pagination conventions
Every Wednesday at 10:00, check whether team's new endpoints meet RESTful Level 3 Richardson Maturity Model
